Reserve Bank of NZ
@ReserveBankofNZ
Aug 18, 2021
The current stimulatory level of monetary settings will be retained, keeping the Official Cash Rate (OCR) at 0.25% for now. Today’s decision was made in the context of the Government’s imposition of Level 4 COVID restrictions on activity across NZ bit.ly/2UscOpf #rbnz
